question: Which guardian deities are invoked to protect the whole body in the forest?
premises: The whole body is named as needing protection.
The forest is specified as the place of protection.
Dhyānānanda and Bodhānanda are invoked as protectors.
inference: Dhyānānanda and Bodhānanda are invoked to protect the entire body in the forest.
uncertainties: The verb of protection is implied from the preceding verses.
plain_english: And may Dhyānānanda protect all my limbs, and Bodhānanda in the forest.
